script_parts.opening: Namaskar, MGN Fine Products se baat ho rahi hai? Main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon — dekh raha tha ki aapka account 8,000 din se zyada purana hai, lekin pichle 30 dino mein sirf 1 active day record hua hai, toh sochaa seedha aapse baat karein.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai ji, ye batayein — kya koi specific wajah hai jiske chalte platform pe login nahi ho pa raha? Matlab kya buyers ke responses satisfactory nahi lag rahe, ya catalog manage karne mein time nahi mil raha, ya kuch aur issue hai jo aapko platform se door kar raha hai?
script_parts.value_demo: Ek important cheez share karna chahta hoon — aapka CQS score abhi 42 hai, jo 60 ke benchmark se kaafi neeche hai, aur iska seedha matlab hai ki search results mein aapki listing bahut peeche aa rahi hai. Upar se BL velocity last month -100% ho gayi, yani jo bhi buyer leads aa rahi thi woh bhi ab rukk gayi hain — yeh gradual drift hai jo 3 mahine se chal raha hai aur agar catalog aur login activity improve ho toh yeh reverse ho sakta hai.
script_parts.action: Toh bhai ji, abhi call pe hi ek kaam karte hain — aap apna catalog ek baar open karein, main aapko dikhata hoon ki CQS score improve karne ke liye konse 2-3 fields — jaise product description, price, aur minimum order quantity — fill karne se sabse zyada fark padega, aur hum milke abhi woh update kar dete hain.
script_parts.close: Bas itna hi chahiye abhi — agle 7 din mein ek baar login karke dekh lena ki leads ka status kaisa hai, aur agar koi doubt ho toh mera number save kar lo, directly call kar lena — koi pressure nahi hai, bas platform aapke liye kaam kare yeh ensure karna chahta hoon.

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, am I speaking with MGN Fine Products? This is calling from IndiaMART — I noticed your account is over 8,000 days old, but in the last 30 days there has been only 1 active day recorded, so I wanted to speak with you directly about this.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: Sir, could you help me understand — is there a specific reason you haven't been logging in regularly? For example, are the buyer responses not meeting expectations, is there a time constraint in managing the catalog, or is there something else that has been pulling you away from the platform?
script_parts_en.value_demo: I want to share one important data point — your CQS score is currently 42, which is well below the 60 benchmark, meaning your listings are ranking quite low in search results. On top of that, your BL velocity has dropped -100% month-on-month, so the buyer lead flow has completely stopped. This is a gradual drift pattern that has been building for 3+ months, but improving catalog completeness and login frequency can reverse this trend.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one concrete thing right now on this call — if you can open your catalog, I'll walk you through exactly 2-3 fields — like product description, pricing, and minimum order quantity — that will have the highest impact on your CQS score, and we can update them together right now.
script_parts_en.close: That's all I'm asking for at this stage — just log in once in the next 7 days and check if the lead status has improved, and if you have any questions, please save my number and call me directly — no pressure at all, I just want to make sure the platform is actually working for you.

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
